In 1999 I was worried about butterfly clips, CDs and whether my low rise jeans were low rise enough. Recovery was… not exactly on the list. 😂 Cut to now and I’m very happy to revisit the Y2K era with a few modern upgrades. The limited edition Theragun Mini Y2K Collection has all the nostalgia in five translucent colorways, plus portable relief for everyday aches, pains and tension. Basically, Y2K me would’ve wanted it because it’s cute. Current me wants it because my body has entered the chat. Shop the limited edition collection now at Therabody.com. @therabody #therabodypartner
